meta.title: 3D Studio · Try it free for 2 days
meta.description: Design tooth gem looks in 3D, show them to your clients, post them on Instagram and order the gems in one click. Free trial, no credit card.

hero.title: Place your gems in 3D before you place them for real.
hero.body: Design the look on a 3D set of teeth, show it to your client, post it on your socials and order the exact gems in one click.
hero.reassurance_one: No credit card · {{count}} day to try everything · then from {{price}} / month
hero.reassurance_other: No credit card · {{count}} days to try everything · then from {{price}} / month
points: Ready to share on Instagram and TikTok

demo.eyebrow: Try it right now, no account
demo.title: Pick a look, change the colour.
demo.body: A 2D preview to get the idea. The real studio is in 3D: you rotate the teeth, place each gem exactly where you want it and choose its size.
demo.canvas: Preview of a tooth gem composition: {{name}}
demo.note: Illustrative 2D preview. This is not the studio: the 3D editor opens with your free trial.

who.title: For everyone who lives and breathes tooth gems.

artists.title: Artists
artists.body: Offer several ideas before the appointment, keep your creations and post them in a few clicks.

salons.title: Salons and studios
salons.body: A placement sheet to print, an estimated quote and a look approved before the gem box is opened.

fans.title: Enthusiasts
fans.body: Imagine your next look, try colours and shapes, then place your order.

steps.title: From first click to first look.

account.title: Create your account
account.body: Free, no credit card. One account for the Studio, the shop and the Academy.

compose.title: Start your trial and design
compose.body: You start the trial when you are ready. Place, move, resize and recolour, in 3D.

share.title: Show, post, order
share.body: Share as an image, video or link, print the placement sheet, add the gems to your cart.

features.title: Everything you need to go from idea to appointment.
features.body: Every feature below is in the Studio today; your plan decides what is unlocked.

library.title: The shop’s real gems
library.body: The library is the shop’s gems: real shapes, colours and sizes, in SS or millimetres. What you see is what you will order.

view3d.title: A 3D set of teeth, from every angle
view3d.body: Rotate, zoom, place gems tooth by tooth, distribute them, undo, start again. A front view of the teeth sums up the composition.

appointment.title: Ready for the appointment
appointment.body: Prepare the session: front view, gem budget estimate and an A4 PDF placement sheet to print.

share.title: Posts ready to publish
share.body: HD image, 360° video or GIF, as Story, square or portrait. One button per network: Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Facebook, Snapchat, WhatsApp, X, Threads.
share.tag: All plans · your own logo from Artist

shop.title: Gems in your cart in one click
shop.body: Your design’s shopping list is worked out for you, with the best mix of packs, and goes straight to the shop cart.

organise.title: Your creations, neatly kept
organise.body: Reusable Gem Groups, folders to sort your creations and Global Toothgems templates to copy and adapt.
organise.tag: Gem Groups from Essential · templates and folders from Artist

glowbook.title: Your public Glowbook
glowbook.body: A page for your Instagram bio: your creations in 3D, your booking links, a QR code and a printable poster. The “certified artist” badge comes with your Academy certificates.

plans.title: Start free, subscribe when you are convinced.
plans.body: The trial opens what the Essential plan includes. After that, monthly or yearly, with no minimum term.
plans.note: Prices include VAT. Cancel any time from your account.

closing.title: Your next look starts here.
closing.body: Create your account, start the trial and place your first gem.
